Creep wave: three melee creeps (unit 3) and one ranged creep (creep_ranged) per lane, every 30 s (480 ticks, reference wave interval) at the base, offset to the lane's row (p2, milli
from the base; top -22000, middle 0, bottom +22000). Each creep then marches to the nearest
enemy building along its lane. Cooldown 480 ticks is the spawn timer.
Hero abilities appended after creep_wave: cleave_strike 3, dash_step 4, ward_shield 5.
reference-style roster (four abilities, then the ultimate, per hero; heroes reference them by name). Mechanics: nuke, projectile,
AoE, blink, heal-over-time, aura, passive, summon, channel, and the status effects stun, slow, silence, root, invisibility.

Skill trees for the three character types in declaration order: hero, ironhide, swiftbow.
Each hero spends one skill point per character level. Four abilities learn up to rank 4; the
ultimate (slot R, the fifth ability) learns up to rank 3 at levels 6, 12 and 18. Rank 1 of
damage, cooldown and energy equals the base values above; ranks 2 and up are scaling.
UNVERIFIED: every rank value below is a design placeholder, not sourced from any game. The
engine has no passive energy regeneration, so energy costs only matter where the caller grants
energy (mend_field's base cost is 50; the other abilities cost nothing).
iron_guard and hawk_eye are passives and carry no skill tree: they cast at spawn, unlearned.
Damage applies to the ability's first damage or heal effect; ability damage tables for
abilities without one are 0.

Status abilities: stun, slow (half speed), silence, root and invisibility, durations in ticks (16 per second).
Wards and courier. The cast cooldown is 1 s = 16 ticks (AbilityCooldown 1.0). The ward placement, its unit and lifetime
(observer 5760 ticks, sentry 6720 ticks: item_ward_observer / item_ward_sentry "lifetime", items.txt
@282fad29f0f74504fad465c52d197fb61f4d612b) and the charge it spends are the pack's (spells.lua WARDS). The cast has no
data effect, so it takes hold, and on_cast places the ward.
Glyph of fortification: for 80 ticks (5 s) every friendly structure that is not a building (the towers) takes no damage;
the team then waits 4800 ticks (300 s). The engine has no glyph effect: protection.lua runs the rule on the cast (on_cast)
through set_damage_reduction and filter_bits. UNVERIFIED: both numbers are recalled reference ruleset values.
